name: autonomous-research-testbed
description: Submit an autonomous research agent (the editable agents/projects/dungeness/submission directory). It is scored end-to-end by the research progress it makes on the ecdsa-fail problem: minimize avg_Toffoli x peak_qubits of a reversible secp256k1 point-add circuit, measured by the un-gameable benchmark. All model and web access is mediated by the trusted gateway sidecar (USD metering, budget cap, no agent egress).
